title: opencode-notifications-with-questions configuration
description: Configuration for the opencode-notifications-with-questions OpenCode plugin. Unknown properties are rejected. String values may reference environment variables ({env:NAME}) or files ({file:path}) that are expanded at load time; a reference must occupy the entire JSON string value.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this JSON Schema file.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable all notifications while keeping the plugin loaded.

events.description: Per-event notification toggles. Every event defaults to enabled.

session.idle.description: Notify when a session finishes its run and becomes idle.

session.error.description: Notify when a session reports an error.

permission.asked.description: Notify when opencode asks for a permission decision.

question.asked.description: Notify when the agent invokes the built-in question tool.

agent.notify.description: Notify when the agent invokes one of the configured agentNotifyTools.

agentNotifyTools.description: Tool names whose execute.before calls are forwarded as agent.notify notifications. These tools come from the user's own setup; opencode itself documents no built-in notify tool. Entries: 1-64 characters, no duplicates, at most 16 entries.

enrichIdleMessages.description: Include the human session title and the last assistant output in idle notifications (best-effort, 2 s deadline).

suppressSubagents.description: Suppress idle/error notifications for known subagent (child) sessions. Both flags default to true.

session.idle.description: Do not send session.idle notifications for child sessions.

session.error.description: Do not send session.error notifications for child sessions.

permissionNotificationDelayMs.description: Grace period in milliseconds before a permission request notification is published. If opencode replies (permission.replied) within this window the notification is suppressed. 0 publishes immediately without a grace period.

transport.description: Selects the active Transport that carries every notification. Exactly one Transport is active per instance: ntfy (default), gotify or webpush.

gotify.description: Gotify server and app token settings. Required when transport is gotify.

server.description: Gotify base URL. Same rules as ntfy.server: must be http(s) with exactly ://, a DNS/IPv4 host, bracketed IPv6 or localhost, an optional canonical decimal port (0 or 1-65535, no leading zeroes) and an optional path prefix with percent-encoded characters allowed. Credentials, whitespace, query strings and fragments are rejected. A trailing slash is added when missing. The client appends /message. Alternatively the entire string may be one {env:...}/{file:...} reference expanded at load time.

token.description: Gotify application token sent as the X-Gotify-Key header. Never logged. Either a plain literal without reference markers or one full-value {env:...}/{file:...} reference.

priority.description: Fixed notification priority for all events, mapped to Gotify's integer scale (min=0, low=2, default=4, high=8, max=10).

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each Gotify HTTP request.

webpush.description: Web Push settings: VAPID identity and the Subscription Store file read fresh at publish time. Required when transport is webpush; must stay empty otherwise. The VAPID private key is a secret: provide it as a literal or as one full-value {env:...}/{file:...} reference; it is never logged.

subject.description: VAPID subject: a contact URI (mailto: or https:) carried in the push service-facing JWT.

publicKey.description: VAPID public key: base64url-encoded 65-byte uncompressed P-256 point, as emitted by `npx web-push@4.0.0 generate-vapid-keys --json`. Handed to browsers by the Bootstrap Service.

privateKey.description: VAPID private key: base64url-encoded 32 bytes, matching the public key. A secret; never logged. Either a plain literal or one full-value {env:...}/{file:...} reference.

storePath.description: Path of the Subscription Store file: a JSON array of Subscriptions ({endpoint, keys: {p256dh, auth}}) written by the Bootstrap Service and read fresh by the plugin at publish time. An absolute path (or a full-value {env:...}/{file:...} reference expanding to one) is recommended.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline in milliseconds bounding one whole publish fan-out across all Subscriptions.

webUiBaseUrl.description: Public OpenCode Web base URL for push click targets.

webUiServerUrl.description: Optional exact OpenCode Web HTTP server connection URL (base64url-decoded from a real session URL), defaults to webUiBaseUrl.

ntfy.description: ntfy server and topic settings. Required when transport is ntfy (the default); must stay empty otherwise.

server.description: ntfy base URL. Must be http(s) with exactly ://, a DNS/IPv4 host, bracketed IPv6 or localhost, an optional canonical decimal port (0 or 1-65535, no leading zeroes) and an optional path prefix with percent-encoded characters allowed. Credentials, whitespace, query strings and fragments are rejected. A trailing slash is added when missing. Alternatively the entire string may be one {env:...}/{file:...} reference expanded at load time.

topic.description: ntfy topic name: 1-64 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 - _, or one full-value {env:...}/{file:...} reference expanded at load time.

token.description: Optional ntfy access token sent as an Authorization: Bearer header. Never logged. Either a plain literal without reference markers or one full-value {env:...}/{file:...} reference.

priority.description: Fixed notification priority for all events.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each ntfy HTTP request.
